case_number: 2024 INSC 890; CIVIL APPEAL NO.12527 of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) No.23347 of 2014)

parties.respondent: M/S Ferrous Alloy Forgings P Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Stamp duty on court-issued sale certificate; title transfers upon sale confirmation, not certificate issuance; certificate merely evidences title under CPC; registration not required under Registration Act s.17(2)(xii); certificate not subject to stamp duty; refund of erroneously paid duty enforced
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XXI Rule 92
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XXI Rule 94
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XXI Rule 94
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XXI Rule 94
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; sale certificate ordered to be issued without stamp duty requirement; refund of stamp duty directed
